message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: defendant contracted a renovation project, got 22 million? Actually 22万元 (220,000). He owes workers 57,000 unpaid wages. He was ordered to pay, he escaped, refused to pay, later paid after police case. So crime: refusing to pay labor remuneration? In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of "拒不支付劳动报酬" (refusal to pay labor remuneration) which is a specific offense under Article 277 of Criminal Law (formerly). The examples earlier: one case about refusing to execute judgment gave "拒不执行判决、裁定". Another about refusing to pay wages gave "拒不支付劳动报酬". Indeed earlier example: "拒不支付劳动报酬" appears for a case about a contractor not paying wages. So answer: [罪名]拒不支付劳动报酬<eoa>. Possibly also "合同诈骗"? But he did not defraud, he just didn't pay wages. He did receive payment for work, but didn't pay workers. That's refusal to pay labor remuneration. So single crime.

Thus final answer JSON with reasoning and final answer.
